dataList.name: นกแห่งการลงทัณฑ์
dataList.desc: สัญญาณเตือนคลิฟอธโอเวอร์โหลดดังก้องไปทั่วโถงทางเดิน มองไปในห้องกักกันที่เกิดการโอเวอร์โหลด พบนกตัวน้อยน่ารักผ่านหน้าต่าง มีโน้ตแปะอยู่บนผนังข้าง ๆ ห้องนี้"งานรับรู้ได้ผลที่ดี" ตัวนับคลิฟอธลดลงมาถึง 10 แล้ว แต่ก็ยังไม่เห็นว่าจะมีพนักงานสักคนมาเลย "ผมจำได้ว่า เอ่อ น่าจะคุณฮอดที่เตือนเราถึงเรื่องอะไรแบบนี้ในครั้งก่อนที่เรามาเยือน...?" "อืม เธอบอกว่าการเพิ่มขึ้นของเกจหลอมละลายจะทำให้บททดสอบมาหา" "ห่ะ? งั้นเราต้องรีบทำอะไรแล้วสิว่ะ! เข้าไปได้แล้ว เร็วเลย!" "คื-คือมันดีจริง ๆ เหรอครับที่เราจะเข้าไป?" มันจะไม่เป็นอะไรใช่ไหมที่เราจะปล่อยมันไปแล้วไปต่อ?

options.message:
สั่งให้ซินเนอร์ที่มีพรมงคลจากหมู่ดาวซีดเผือดทำ"งานรับรู้" กับสิ่งผิดปกติ
<size=75%><color=#a16a3b>ตัวเลือกสามารถเลือกได้หากมี "พรมงคลจากหมู่ดาวซีดเผือด"</color></size>
options.messageDesc: เลือกเพื่อรับของขวัญ E.G.O เลือดไหล
result:
นกตัวเล็กไล่จิกซินเนอร์อย่างกับมันเป็นเจ้าก้อนขนจอมโมโห แต่เพราะพรคุ้มครองซินเนอร์จึงทำงานได้เสร็จด้วยดี
ดูเหมือนบางอย่างจะทำให้เจ้านกโดนใจ มันเลยนำสร้อยคอที่แขวนอยู่บนกิ่งที่มันเกาะ มาคล้องคอของซินเนอร์

options.message: สั่งให้ซินเนอร์ทำ "งานรับรู้"
options.messageDesc: Sloth & Wrath Advantage check. Pass to gain a Bleed E.G.O Gift.

options.message: ออกมาจากโถงทางเดิน
options.messageDesc: No particular effect
result:
<มีใครรู้วิธีจัดการกับสิ่งนี้ไหม?>
"......."
<...เผ่นกันเถอะ>

การทำงานกับสิ่งผิดปกติที่เราไม่รู้วิธีจัดการไม่ใช่อะไรที่ดีเลย
พวกเรารีบหนีจากโถงทางเดินนั้นอย่างรวดเร็ว ก่อนที่ตัวนับคลิฟอธจะถึง 0

dataList.name: Choice Event for resting
dataList.desc:
In the staff lounge, we come across employees in E.G.O Gears standing around, chatting amongst themselves.
Each of them holds a white coffee mug in their hand.

"Eh? Haven't seen you guys around. Which department are you from?"

options.message:
Tell them that we're from the Upper Layer, and present our E.G.O Gifts.
<size=75%><color=#a16a3b>Choice unlocked by carrying 5+ Theme Pack-exclusive E.G.O Gifts from "The Noon of Violet" and "Hatred and Despair" Packs</color></size>
options.messageDesc: Select to gain a Keywordless E.G.O Gift
result:
A look of pity passes over their eyes when they lay upon the variety of E.G.O Gifts we're carrying.

"And yet, you're still in one piece."
"How are things in the Upper Layer? Heard workload's pretty heavy up there."

One of the employees briefly leaves the circle of condolences before returning with a mug of coffee.

"C'mon, chin up. Let's survive another day, huh?"

options.message: Tell them that we're from the Disciplinary Team.
options.messageDesc: No particular effect
result:
"... Oh. So you are."

An uncomfortable, strained silence falls upon the employee lounge.
We stood around for a few miserable minutes until even their coffee became lukewarm.

dataList.name: Alriune Choice Event (#1)
dataList.desc:
The elevator door opens into a dark, unlit hallway.
We can smell the vivid and intense aroma of fresh, blossoming flowers that have grown over the walls and the floors of the hallway.

Lying lethargically atop the bed of flowers are employees, their eyes shut as though in drowsiness.

options.messageDesc: Gain a Sinking E.G.O Gift depending on the result of the following choice
result:
It's not too late for them.
Maybe we can save them by moving them into the elevator.

options.messageDesc: No particular effect
result:
It might be too late for them.
We should find a different way around this hallway.

dataList.name: Alriune Choice Event (#2)
dataList.desc:
By the time we had finished moving the employees to the elevator,
we heard a chilling scream echoing from the center of the hallway.

There, we saw panicked employees curled up into balls...
... and an eyeless monster looming over them, its body shaped like a ceramic doll.

It was at that moment when a large flower bloomed by the monster's feet.

options.messageDesc: Gain a Sinking E.G.O Gift depending on the result of the following choice
result: Moved the panicked employees to the elevator.

options.message: This time, give up on them.
options.messageDesc: Select to gain a Sinking E.G.O Gift
result: We returned, leaving the employees behind.

dataList.name: Alriune Choice Event (#3)
dataList.desc:
Another huge flower is blooming by the eyeless monster's feet.
We've saved everyone we could.
What now?

options.messageDesc: Select to gain a Sinking E.G.O Gift
result:
We should at least try to suppress it.
When we approached the monster, another flower blossomed beneath the monster's feet.

At that moment, verdant, vivid leaves burst forth from the ceiling, then scattered over us in a downpour of pink flowers.
We stood blinded by the swirling storm of petals for a moment, until the Sinners all grabbed their heads and began yelling in pain.

Once the floral tempest subsided, the monster was nowhere to be seen.

options.messageDesc: Select to gain a Sinking E.G.O Gift
result:
There is something anxiety-inducing about the unsettling aroma permeating the hallway.
After grabbing whatever seemed useful from the unconscious employees, we fled.

dataList.name: Queen Bee Gift Options
dataList.desc:
The employee at the laboratory began in a level voice.

"Ah, you're right on time. The higher-ups ordered us to observe the subject's responses to types of Work other than Insight Work."
"Don't worry, it won't be very complicated. Just hold your breath, take this piece of meat, and hand it over to the bees.
"I'd really appreciate your help, if it isn't too much trouble."

I followed his gaze to the surveillance monitor of the containment unit, its camera pointed toward a massive bee with a torso that looked more like a beehive.

options.messageDesc: Wrath & Sloth Advantage check. Pass to gain a Burn E.G.O Gift.
No particular effect
result:
"Ah, well. I haven't managed this Abnormality before, but looks like I've got to go in there myself."

Once the employee exited the containment unit, he began constantly scratching at his neck and arms.
We left him to his itchy troubles and left the scene.

dataList.name: Singing Machine Gift Options
dataList.desc:
There's someone crying inside the containment unit.
We peered inside to find a suspicious figure, wearing an outfit that stood out from those of the employees.
Noticing our presence, he suddenly approached us, beaming.

"I-I have to tune my instrument to perfect accuracy, but I don't have anyone to help me."
"Do you... like music? Help me, and I'll give you one of my instruments."
"H-how about it? Deal?"

options.message: Agree to help, and ask for a guitar.
options.messageDesc: Wrath & Lust Advantage check. Pass to gain a Bleed E.G.O Gift.

options.message: Agree to help, and ask for a bass guitar.
options.messageDesc: Wrath & Lust Advantage check. Pass to gain a Bleed E.G.O Gift.
No particular effect
result:
"... No. I have to... I have to hear its flawless, wondrous song again. If I can't..."
"I-I have to play that music again with my own hands. How can I do that if I can't tune the instruments myself?"

He flicks his gaze toward the Sinners, madness clear in his eyes.
Unsettled, we quickly distanced ourselves from the containment unit.

dataList.name: Singing Machine Gift Option 2 - Harmony Guitar
dataList.desc:
The instrument sounds much better, finally tuned correctly.
Upon reviewing the instrument he gave us, it was clear that it would be of much help to us going forward.
We asked if there was any way we could get more instruments out of him.

"N-no. I can't hear its beautiful music anymore."
"... Keep playing the music, until I feel satisfied. T-then I'll hand you an extra instrument."

options.messageDesc: Wrath & Lust Advantage check. Pass to gain a Bleed E.G.O Gift.
No particular effect
result:
"With this, I should be able to play plenty of good music for a while. Thank you."

We left, the sound of music growing faint as we walked away from the containment chamber.
